target_customer: Restaurants (planned $300 per month) whose diners order from their phones
problem: Ordering from a waiter is slow; diners scan a QR code at the table, order and pay from a web page without an app.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription ($300 per month planned) plus sale of aggregated menu-choice data

technical_complexity.rationale: Web ordering plus payments and QR codes is standard CRUD and payment integration; no app required.

defensibility.rationale: Easily copyable; restaurant POS and ordering vendors could add the same flow.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sources describe incumbent actions at the time.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence found. A search snippet notes iPhone cameras gained native QR scanning in 2017, which would have lowered friction.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence; name collides with many menu-related products.

outcome_analysis: OurMenu joined YC W18 with a QR-code table ordering idea and a planned $300 monthly fee, then became Inactive. No shutdown announcement, funding record or post-mortem was found, so the cause of the shutdown is not public (and neither is the date). The idea was early for restaurant QR ordering, which only became widespread around 2020, but no source ties its end to timing.
notes: Exit type set to shutdown to match directory status Inactive; no source states a shutdown event or date. Aggregators (Seedtable) show no funding rounds, which is not proof of none. Founding year unknown (launched_at in directory 2017-11). No dated competitor evidence found; later QR ordering vendors not used. Outcome and branding searches found nothing beyond directories. The company site ourmenu.io was not verified as live or dead.
